**Finding: deviation (WARRANTY)** — submitted.

- **What the document has:** Section 9 ("TRUELINK WARRANTIES", p0059–p0060) is limited to a Y2K date-processing warranty. Section 8 covers only Client's warranties (including, notably, a malicious-code warranty running *from* us). Section 2's response-time (p0032) and availability (p0034) provisions are "reasonable commercial efforts" service descriptions with no warranty remedy. Section 12 (p0076) disclaims all implied warranties "except as expressly set forth," leaving effectively no performance warranty for us to rely on.
- **Why it fails the fallback:** No professional/workmanlike standard, no conformance-to-documentation period (not even 90 days), no compliance-with-laws or vendor malicious-code warranty, and no repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** a new Section 9a inserting the preferred warranty package (workmanlike services, 12-month conformance for the Interface and software, compliance with laws, no malicious code), a repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy at TrueLink's option, and an express carve-out from the Section 12 disclaimer. The comment offers a 90-day conformance period as the fallback.
